settings.title: Settings
settings.slippageTip: Maximum price change you're willing to accept. Higher slippage increases the chance of a successful swap but may result in a worse rate.
settings.networkTip: Select the blockchain network for your swap. Different networks have different gas fees.
settings.refreshRateTip: How often exchange rates are automatically fetched from the price API.
settings.apiEndpointTip: The API endpoint used to fetch live token prices for exchange rate calculations.
